objective: Create an original, physically credible documentary-style film about a distinctive fictional superyacht, from collaborative design through construction, finishing, delivery and guest experience.
identity_dimensions: Deck relationships, circulation and signature spaces
state_change_means: Either the stage of construction the vessel has reached, or the way a space aboard transforms in use.
scale_anchor: A standing person at distance reads the size of a superyacht. Use one where scale matters; it is guidance, not a requirement for every scene.

coverage_policy.shown: Show observable action or a visible result supporting the item.
coverage_policy.transition: Name the scenes the transition sits between, and state the progress that is being skipped.
coverage_policy.not_applicable: Kept in the draft for a reviewer to judge. It never satisfies a required item and never authorises production.

coverage.label: Establish the design question and constraints.
The design team settles the vessel's distinguishing architectural idea.
Establish coherent deck levels, spaces and circulation.
Design and engineering coordinate the proposed arrangement without invented certification claims.
The yard receives the agreed design and understands the work to execute.
Establish a prepared worksite, supports, access and staged material.
Show or establish progress of the lower hull structure.
Show or establish the framing that gives the hull its volume.
Crews enclose supported hull structure while retaining the design's defining openings.
Establish the decks and their spatial relationships.
Crews realize the distinctive superstructure form.
Establish machinery and service installation with credible access.
Check completed work; if a deviation is shown, resolve it before dependent work proceeds.
Outfitting teams receive the relevant completed work areas.
Establish surface preparation and coating progress.
Establish glazing installation consistent with the vessel's design.
Establish interior fit-out, materials and usable circulation.
Show the signature spaces becoming complete and recognizable.
Resolve outstanding work if present; do not invent defects.
Teams review finished spaces without implying unsupported technical approval.
Reveal the completed vessel as a coherent architectural whole.
Establish launch and the transition from supported hull to afloat vessel.
Establish trial activity without inventing performance figures or certification.
Show meaningful transfer to the owner representative and operating crew.
Show or establish crew operation and guest service.
A guest group experiences the specific spatial qualities promised by the design.
